title: Regex — Where It Stands
thesis: Under the hood it is PCRE2 10.47, statically linked, Unicode always on, with an unusually rich Ring layer (100+ methods, four fluent builder classes, a reactive match-to-code engine). On features it is at PCRE2 parity, with lookaround, backreferences, recursion and conditionals that RE2 and Rust refuse. Where it trails the modern engines is the safety-and-throughput story: no JIT, no linear-time matcher, and the ReDoS knob is not reachable from Ring, although the code for both is already compiled into the binary.

lanes.note: Match() anchors whole content, MatchFirst() searches, MatchAt(s,n) from a position, plus partial as-you-type mode (PARTIAL_HARD/SOFT); nothing structural owed
Numbered and named captures with positions and section variants; Ring re-derives names in source order because PCRE2 enumerates them alphabetically
PCRE2 compiled with UTF | UCP unconditionally: p{L}, scripts, codepoint-correct w/d/dot over multibyte UTF-8, offset conversion at the boundary
Full PCRE2 set proven by engine tests: lookaround, backrefs, atomic, possessive, non-capturing, recursion (?R), conditionals; RE2 and Rust omit these
Engine-backed replace with $1 / ${1} / backref and $$ via StzRegexReplace and ReplaceRegex; ${name} parsed but only numeric honored; no Replace on stzRegex
Single-pass FindAllRegex / extract_all (O(n)) plus stzRegex Matches/MatchesZZ and SplitByRegex; split_get silently caps at 512 pieces
Standard modifiers plus auto-multiline; compiles once, recompiles only on flag change; :DontCapture, :DisableOptimizations, :UseUnicode are no-ops; no cache
Four builders (stzRegexMaker, Recursive, Conditional W-DSL, Lookaround) emitting patterns; Quantifiers() is an empty TODO, MatchSameContentAs has a param bug
stzRegexuter: a trigger-pattern-code engine with @value, state tracking, dependency chains, per-position results; novel, built on eval()
4,842-line catalogue (stzRegexData.ring) via rxp()/pat(); Explain() works only for named patterns, the fallback calls a nonexistent stzRegexAnalyzer
One backtracking pcre2_match path; pcre2_jit_compile and pcre2_dfa_match are compiled into the binary but never called
stz_regex_set_limits(steps, input_len, depth) exists (engine test proves (a+)+$ aborts, ~10M-step default) but no Ring stzRegex method calls it

standouts: Feature-complete PCRE2: lookaround, backrefs, recursion, conditionals that RE2 and Rust deliberately refuse
The clearest match-semantics API in its class: Match() anchors, MatchFirst() searches, partial as-you-type
Four fluent builder classes with no native peer
gaps: Wire the linear-time DFA matcher (pcre2_dfa_match is already in the binary)
Surface the ReDoS limits on the Ring stzRegex class
Fix the broken Explain fallback (missing stzRegexAnalyzer) and the builder stubs
